bayts.text: I have turned all of me to the Loving, the Eternal Refuge, possessed of service to the Chosen, Muḥammad.
Praise and gratitude together to Allah, for the Prophet, son of ʿAbd Allāh.
To Allah, with the wise Remembrance, I turn, together with the Prophet, son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.
My Lord scattered for me the ranks of an oppressive enemy, by the standing of the Chosen, son of Hāshim.
My Lord bestowed on me a gift that has been exalted, through the Chosen, the Elect, of (the line of) ʿAbd Manāf.
My supplication my Lord has answered, in secret, through the Chosen, of (the line of) Quṣayy.
I ask Him for the attainment of wishes without despoiling and without delusion, through the Prophet son of Kilāb.
Bestow good on me and spare me harm, Lord, by the standing of the Elect, son of Murra.
Make my heart good with a garden hard (to reach) for me, forever, by the Chosen son of Kaʿb.
O Allah, O Lord of the Throne and the Footstool, bless with peace the (descendant) of Luʾayy.
O Lord, drive to me all the requests without reckoning, through the Prophet son of Ghālib.
O Originator, subject to me every month and every day, through the Prophet son of Fihr.
O Best of helpers and Best of kings, help and give me mastery, through the son of Mālik.
My hidden treasure, my glory and my radiance is Your being for me: so be for me, through an-Naḍr.
Tame the enemies for me and grant me his shield, through the Chosen, the Elect, of (the line of) Kināna.
Bestow on me that with which I illumine a tent, and more, through him who illumined Khuzayma.
Save my side from the neighbourhood of a polytheist woman and man, through the Chosen son of Mudrika.
Bless for me, O Allah, my reasoning, through him whom You made the light of Ilyās.
Help my side in travel and at rest, and bring me near to You by the standing of the son of Muḍar.
Grant me the favour, Lord, that I be visited in You and in the best of creation, the light of Nizār.
You guided me, O Best Guide Who promised: You fulfilled the promise for me through the most excellent of Maʿadd.
You granted me a grace (leading) to the Gardens, raising all of me, through the Prophet, the ʿAdnānite.
The blessings of the Truthful (Abū Bakr) and the Discerner (ʿUmar) gather the gathered and the scattered.
The Lord of the Throne honoured the Possessor of the Two Lights (ʿUthmān) and the father of the two grandsons (ʿAlī), in the two Abodes.
The God-fearing Companions of the Prophet repelled (the enemies) — upon them good pleasure —: the (sway of the) wretched was effaced.
He to whom Ḥayzūm belongs (Gabriel) repelled the Accursed, with the enemies: and their army is routed.
The people of Badr raised Islām, and removed the wicked and the darknesses.
The slinking Whisperer has returned with what grieves him, and gladdened is he at whose side people have made their mounts kneel.
For us appeared the affirmation of Oneness and jurisprudence together with Sufism, through him who repressed our enemies.
The gift of Allah, the Loving, the Eternal Refuge, has made my life abide through the Prophet Muḥammad.
